payload.text: Okay, I will answer. The something that I own, which is very important to me, is my phone. I got it from my boyfriend that buy it to me. I have this phone maybe a year ago. I use this phone for everything, like for banking, for groceries, and for chatting with other people to make a connection and to do a job, of course. I think it's not valuable in terms of the money because the phone is very important to me. Everything I have is on my phone. For example, a picture who has some memories, money for buy anything, and contact, like for the connectivity with other people. It's not easy to replace my phone with the other thing in the world.

provenance.reference: Respons bahasa Inggris Tata di chat ini pada 13 Oktober 2026 untuk Speaking Part 2 phone. Hanya teks yang diterima; asal dictation/transcription dan durasi tidak diketahui, tidak ada file audio tersedia untuk diperiksa.

result.verification_method: Feedback AI dari teks respons yang dikirim Tata; dibandingkan cue card resmi Part 2. Tidak ada audio yang diterima/diperiksa.

criteria.fluency_coherence: Isi mencakup seluruh cue: phone, pemberian boyfriend, sekitar satu tahun, penggunaan harian dan kepentingan personal. Urutan dapat diikuti. Kecepatan, jeda dan fluency lisan belum dapat dinilai. Makna monetary value versus personal importance perlu diperjelas.
criteria.lexical_resource: Kosakata banking, groceries, chatting dan memories relevan. Collocation/word form belum natural pada buy it to me, picture who has memories, money for buy, connectivity.
criteria.grammatical_range_accuracy: Meaning umumnya dapat dipahami. Kesalahan terlihat pada past-time verb: boyfriend that buy it to me, I have this phone maybe a year ago; pilih bought it for me dan have had it for about a year. Perlu to buy, photos that hold memories dan contacts untuk makna yang dimaksud.

result.uncertainty: Sampel satu Part 2 dalam teks saja; asal transkripsi dan durasi belum diketahui. Tidak menilai pronunciation atau fluency lisan, tidak memberi band Speaking. Koreksi mengacu bentuk teks yang tersedia, tanpa mengasumsikan persis bunyi audio.

feedback.strength: Respons menjawab seluruh poin kartu dan memberi contoh konkret kegunaan phone: banking, groceries, chatting, photos dan contacts.
patterns: Bentuk kata kerja untuk pengalaman lampau/durasi belum tepat: bought it for me; I have had this phone for about a year.
Pilihan frasa perlu lebih natural dan jelas: photos that hold memories; money to buy things; kontak personal. Bedakan monetary value dari sentimental/personal value tanpa mengasumsikan harga phone.
feedback.action: Ulangi secara lisan bagian asal phone dan lama kepemilikan dalam 2–3 kalimat, gunakan bought it for me dan have had it for about a year. Bila dikirim, checkpoint sebagai revisi review terpisah.
feedback.next_task: Writing International Tourism Task 2 micro-task: posisi + satu paragraf; cadangan Further Education Task 1 introduction + overview. Feedback aspek yang terlihat tanpa band task.
